say: Every to-do app assumes you have the same energy every day. For students living with chronic illness, A.D.H.D., or depression, that just isn't true. On a bad day, the list doesn't shrink. It just turns into guilt.

say: Spoonful is built on spoon theory. You get a limited number of spoons each day, and every task costs some. So Spoonful starts with one question. How much energy do you have right now?
